background.title: IPCC 与《二氧化碳捕集与封存特别报告》
background.text_zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）由联合国环境规划署和世界气象组织于1988年共同设立，本身不做实验，只对已发表的文献做评估。它除定期发布评估报告外，还应成员国要求编写“特别报告”。文中这场2005年的奥维耶多会议，正是为了定稿《二氧化碳捕集与封存特别报告》（SRCCS）。IPCC 有一条特殊规则：报告正文由科学家撰写，但“决策者摘要”须由各国政府代表逐行审议通过——这意味着产油国政府在文本定调上有直接的发言权，这也是文中“产油国施压”能奏效的制度背景。报告一旦发布，即成为各国政策、碳市场与气候谈判的通用参考，所以“正当性”效应能持续很久。

background.title: CCS 是什么，为什么化石燃料行业力挺它
background.text_zh: 碳捕集与封存（CCS）指在发电厂、水泥厂、天然气处理等排放源把二氧化碳分离出来，经管道或船舶运输后注入深层咸水层或枯竭油气田长期封存。它技术链条长、成本高、能耗大，且封存环节的长期泄漏风险难以用短周期实验验证——这正是文中科学家为难的地方。对石油公司而言，CCS 还有一重现实好处：注入的二氧化碳可用于“强化采油”（EOR），把难以开采的原油驱赶出来，因而减排投入可以转化为产量。对产油国来说，CCS 提供了一套话语：不必削减化石燃料产量，只需处理排放。这一“技术中立”的外衣，是它能进入联合国报告并影响此后数十年气候政策讨论的关键。

title_en: Federal and State Officials Ramp Up Scrutiny of DraftKings, Other Sports Betting Apps
excerpt_en: The post Federal and State Officials Ramp Up Scrutiny of DraftKings, Other Sports Betting Apps appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: Connecticut Sen. Richard Blumenthal, one of three federal lawmakers who recently cited ProPublica reporting in a letter asking sports betting companies for more information about their business practices. Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images State and federal officials have ramped up scrutiny of online sports betting companies in recent weeks, launching inquiries, demanding information and, in one case, proposing a new rule that would limit when companies like DraftKings can pitch their users to bet more.

The moves — by gaming regulators, government lawyers and federal lawmakers — follow an investigation last month by ProPublica that tested the guardrails DraftKings and other sports betting companies have in place to protect users from spiraling out of control. That system is called responsible gaming, and executives say it’s integral to their companies’ long-term success.

The ProPublica article showed how DraftKings bestowed VIP status on a reporter who deliberately bet like a problem gambler. The report detailed the ways in which the app’s user design and promotions encouraged more betting — even after the reporter opted into responsible gaming tools designed to slow users down. A week earlier, The New York Times reported that DraftKings had used machine learning and artificial intelligence to target promotions to losing bettors.

Those articles were the focus of an Oct. 15 meeting of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board, which, partly in response to the stories, tabled the renewal of DraftKings’ five-year license. Instead, the board granted the company a temporary four-month permit while investigators look into the issues raised in the reports as well as other paperwork concerns.
The board’s chair, Christopher Hebert, said the Times had raised some “very serious questions” and called ProPublica’s reporting “very troubling.”

While news stories “are not findings of regulatory violations,” Hebert said, “as regulators we have a responsibility to examine these matters that could affect the integrity of gaming operations and the protections of our citizens here in Louisiana.”

State health officials say the number of Louisianans believed to have a gambling disorder has risen in recent years amid the surge in popularity of online gambling and prediction market sites. One top official reported this summer that gambling addiction was among the health department’s “top three priorities.”

What Does Your Data Reveal About Sports Betting Apps? Help ProPublica Find Out. If you’ve bet on sports with FanDuel or DraftKings, you can help ProPublica understand how these apps work. Use our browser extension to download your betting history, then upload your files.

Share Your Experience Paul Liberman, who co-founded DraftKings and serves as its president of operations, told the regulators: “We do not use artificial intelligence to target losing gamblers by any means.”

DraftKings previously told ProPublica that it proactively closes the accounts of suspected problem gamblers “all the time” but declined to provide specific figures. Yet when asked by a Louisiana board member for those same specifics, Lori Kalani, DraftKings’ chief responsible gaming officer, said 175 accounts in the state had been shut down this year. She told the board she didn’t know how many total users DraftKings had in the Pelican State.

“We’re not physicians, we’re not clinicians and that’s not our role, but we certainly want to help people enjoy the service, the platform that we’re offering them,” Kalani told the board. “I know that we’re doing our job and that when we see something, we say something and we engage. I just can’t tell you if 175 is the right number. I wish it was zero.”

In a statement, a DraftKings spokesperson said: “As a legal, regulated operator, DraftKings values an open and ongoing dialogue with regulators and regular conversations and check-ins with regulators are normal course of business.”

In response to ProPublica’s original investigation, Kalani said DraftKings’ responsible gaming system — which consists largely of in-app messages about the company’s tools — “worked the way it was supposed to.” She cautioned against “drawing broad conclusions” from one user’s experience.

The day after the Louisiana meeting, regulators in Ohio proposed an amendment to the state’s sports gaming rule that would bar companies like DraftKings from sending direct ads or marketing to bettors for 48 hours after they’d opted into responsible gaming tools or updated their current settings.

The proposed amendment speaks directly to a finding in ProPublica’s reporting: After blowing nearly $4,500 betting on tennis in 24 hours, the reporter used such tools to limit the amount of time and money he could spend on the app. Just 30 minutes later, though, he received the first of four push notifications promoting new betting opportunities. It wasn’t until he opted into a far more restrictive tool, called a “cool-off,” that the notifications temporarily stopped.

Andromeda Morrison, the interim executive director of the Ohio Casino Control Commission, said that though her office had been working on its proposal for some time, ProPublica’s story illuminated the issue. “Hopefully this is something that is fairly easy for the industry to see as a common sense restriction to make sure those consumers are making good choices without those push notifications,” she said.

But Keith Whyte, a former director of the National Council on Problem Gambling who now consults for industry and nonprofit groups, said the proposed amendment could unintentionally disincentivize users from using tools like deposit limits. “I think the implication is that using a responsible gaming tool is a sign of a gambling problem,” he said. The measure faces a long rulemaking process, including more rounds of public hearings and comments.

enrich.title_zh: 联邦与州官员加大对DraftKings等体育博彩应用的审查力度
enrich.summary_zh: ProPublica揭露DraftKings等体育博彩应用诱导问题赌徒下注后，路易斯安那州暂缓其牌照续期、改发四个月临时许可，俄亥俄州拟禁止用户启用负责任博彩工具后48小时内推送营销；联邦议员与州监管、卫生部门同步加压。公司辩称系统运作正常，亦有专家担心新规反让用户回避限制工具。

paragraphs.en: Connecticut Sen. Richard Blumenthal, one of three federal lawmakers who recently cited ProPublica reporting in a letter asking sports betting companies for more information about their business practices. Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images State and federal officials have ramped up scrutiny of online sports betting companies in recent weeks, launching inquiries, demanding information and, in one case, proposing a new rule that would limit when companies like DraftKings can pitch their users to bet more.
paragraphs.zh:
康涅狄格州参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔（Richard Blumenthal），是最近致信体育博彩公司、要求其提供更多业务操作信息的三位联邦议员之一，信中引用了ProPublica的报道。图片来源：Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images

近几周，州和联邦官员加大了对在线体育博彩公司的审查力度：启动调查、要求提供信息，并在其中一例中提出新规，限制DraftKings这类公司向用户推销“再多下点注”的时机。

paragraphs.en: The moves — by gaming regulators, government lawyers and federal lawmakers — follow an investigation last month by ProPublica that tested the guardrails DraftKings and other sports betting companies have in place to protect users from spiraling out of control. That system is called responsible gaming, and executives say it’s integral to their companies’ long-term success.
paragraphs.zh: 这些行动来自博彩监管机构、政府律师和联邦议员，发生在上月ProPublica的一项调查之后。该调查检验了DraftKings等体育博彩公司为保护用户不至于失控而设置的防护机制。这套系统被称为“负责任博彩”（responsible gaming），高管们称其对公司的长期成功不可或缺。

paragraphs.en: The ProPublica article showed how DraftKings bestowed VIP status on a reporter who deliberately bet like a problem gambler. The report detailed the ways in which the app’s user design and promotions encouraged more betting — even after the reporter opted into responsible gaming tools designed to slow users down. A week earlier, The New York Times reported that DraftKings had used machine learning and artificial intelligence to target promotions to losing bettors.
paragraphs.zh: ProPublica的文章显示，DraftKings如何将VIP身份授予一名刻意模仿问题赌徒下注的记者。报道详细描述了该应用的用户设计和促销手段如何鼓励用户下更多注——即便在记者已经启用旨在让用户“慢下来”的负责任博彩工具之后。再早一周，《纽约时报》报道称，DraftKings利用机器学习和人工智能，把促销精准投向输钱的投注者。

paragraphs.en: Those articles were the focus of an Oct. 15 meeting of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board, which, partly in response to the stories, tabled the renewal of DraftKings’ five-year license. Instead, the board granted the company a temporary four-month permit while investigators look into the issues raised in the reports as well as other paperwork concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 这些报道成为路易斯安那州博彩控制委员会10月15日会议的焦点。该委员会部分出于对这些报道的回应，搁置了DraftKings五年期牌照的续期。委员会改为向该公司发放一张为期四个月的临时许可，同时调查人员就报道中提出的问题以及其他文书方面的疑虑展开调查。

paragraphs.en: The board’s chair, Christopher Hebert, said the Times had raised some “very serious questions” and called ProPublica’s reporting “very troubling.”
paragraphs.zh: 委员会主席克里斯托弗·赫伯特（Christopher Hebert）说，《纽约时报》提出了某些“非常严肃的问题”，并称ProPublica的报道“非常令人不安”。

paragraphs.en: While news stories “are not findings of regulatory violations,” Hebert said, “as regulators we have a responsibility to examine these matters that could affect the integrity of gaming operations and the protections of our citizens here in Louisiana.”
paragraphs.zh: 赫伯特说，虽然新闻报道“并不等同于认定存在监管违规”，“但作为监管者，我们有责任审查这些可能影响博彩运营诚信、影响路易斯安那州公民所受保护的事项。”

paragraphs.en: State health officials say the number of Louisianans believed to have a gambling disorder has risen in recent years amid the surge in popularity of online gambling and prediction market sites. One top official reported this summer that gambling addiction was among the health department’s “top three priorities.”
paragraphs.zh: 州卫生官员表示，随着在线博彩和预测市场网站人气飙升，近年来被认为患有赌博障碍的路易斯安那州居民人数有所上升。一位高级官员今年夏天表示，赌博成瘾是该卫生部门的“三大优先事项”之一。

paragraphs.en: What Does Your Data Reveal About Sports Betting Apps? Help ProPublica Find Out. If you’ve bet on sports with FanDuel or DraftKings, you can help ProPublica understand how these apps work. Use our browser extension to download your betting history, then upload your files.
paragraphs.zh: 【征集读者】你的数据能揭示体育博彩应用的什么？帮ProPublica找出答案。如果你曾在FanDuel或DraftKings上下注，你可以帮助ProPublica了解这些应用是如何运作的。使用我们的浏览器扩展下载你的投注历史，然后上传你的文件。

paragraphs.en: Share Your Experience Paul Liberman, who co-founded DraftKings and serves as its president of operations, told the regulators: “We do not use artificial intelligence to target losing gamblers by any means.”
paragraphs.zh: 【分享你的经历】保罗·利伯曼（Paul Liberman）是DraftKings的联合创始人兼运营总裁，他对监管者说：“我们绝不以任何方式利用人工智能来锁定输钱的赌徒。”

paragraphs.en: DraftKings previously told ProPublica that it proactively closes the accounts of suspected problem gamblers “all the time” but declined to provide specific figures. Yet when asked by a Louisiana board member for those same specifics, Lori Kalani, DraftKings’ chief responsible gaming officer, said 175 accounts in the state had been shut down this year. She told the board she didn’t know how many total users DraftKings had in the Pelican State.
paragraphs.zh: DraftKings此前对ProPublica表示，公司“一直”主动关闭疑似问题赌徒的账户，但拒绝提供具体数字。然而，当路易斯安那州一位委员会成员问起同样的具体数据时，DraftKings首席负责任博彩官洛里·卡拉尼（Lori Kalani）表示，今年该州已有175个账户被关闭。她告诉委员会，她不知道DraftKings在“鹈鹕州”（路易斯安那州别称）总共有多少用户。

paragraphs.en: “We’re not physicians, we’re not clinicians and that’s not our role, but we certainly want to help people enjoy the service, the platform that we’re offering them,” Kalani told the board. “I know that we’re doing our job and that when we see something, we say something and we engage. I just can’t tell you if 175 is the right number. I wish it was zero.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们不是医生，也不是临床医师，那不是我们的职责；但我们当然希望帮助人们享受我们提供的服务、享受这个平台，”卡拉尼对委员会说。“我知道我们在尽职，看到问题时我们会发声、会介入。我只是无法告诉你175是不是一个合适的数字。我倒希望它是零。”

paragraphs.en: In a statement, a DraftKings spokesperson said: “As a legal, regulated operator, DraftKings values an open and ongoing dialogue with regulators and regular conversations and check-ins with regulators are normal course of business.”
paragraphs.zh: 在一份声明中，DraftKings的一位发言人说：“作为一家合法、受监管的运营商，DraftKings重视与监管者之间公开、持续的对话，与监管者定期沟通和汇报属于正常业务范畴。”

paragraphs.en: In response to ProPublica’s original investigation, Kalani said DraftKings’ responsible gaming system — which consists largely of in-app messages about the company’s tools — “worked the way it was supposed to.” She cautioned against “drawing broad conclusions” from one user’s experience.
paragraphs.zh: 针对ProPublica最初的调查，卡拉尼表示，DraftKings的负责任博彩系统——主要由应用内介绍公司各类工具的提示信息构成——“按预期发挥了作用”。她提醒不要根据单个用户的经历“得出宽泛的结论”。

paragraphs.en: The day after the Louisiana meeting, regulators in Ohio proposed an amendment to the state’s sports gaming rule that would bar companies like DraftKings from sending direct ads or marketing to bettors for 48 hours after they’d opted into responsible gaming tools or updated their current settings.
paragraphs.zh: 路易斯安那会议次日，俄亥俄州监管者提出一项对该州体育博彩规则的修正案，将禁止DraftKings这类公司在投注者启用负责任博彩工具或更新现有设置后的48小时内，向其发送直接广告或营销信息。

paragraphs.en: The proposed amendment speaks directly to a finding in ProPublica’s reporting: After blowing nearly $4,500 betting on tennis in 24 hours, the reporter used such tools to limit the amount of time and money he could spend on the app. Just 30 minutes later, though, he received the first of four push notifications promoting new betting opportunities. It wasn’t until he opted into a far more restrictive tool, called a “cool-off,” that the notifications temporarily stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 这项拟议修正案直接呼应了ProPublica报道中的一项发现：在24小时内于网球投注上输掉近4500美元后，这名记者使用了此类工具，限制自己在应用上花费的时间和金钱。然而仅仅30分钟后，他就收到了四条推广新投注机会的推送通知中的第一条。直到他启用了一项限制性强得多的工具——“冷静期”（cool-off）——这些通知才暂时停止。

paragraphs.en: Andromeda Morrison, the interim executive director of the Ohio Casino Control Commission, said that though her office had been working on its proposal for some time, ProPublica’s story illuminated the issue. “Hopefully this is something that is fairly easy for the industry to see as a common sense restriction to make sure those consumers are making good choices without those push notifications,” she said.
paragraphs.zh: 俄亥俄州赌场控制委员会临时执行主任安德洛墨达·莫里森（Andromeda Morrison）说，尽管她的办公室为这项提案已经工作了一段时间，但ProPublica的报道让这一问题凸显出来。“希望这能让业界相当容易地把它看作一项常识性的限制，确保这些消费者在没有那些推送通知的情况下做出好的选择，”她说。

paragraphs.en: But Keith Whyte, a former director of the National Council on Problem Gambling who now consults for industry and nonprofit groups, said the proposed amendment could unintentionally disincentivize users from using tools like deposit limits. “I think the implication is that using a responsible gaming tool is a sign of a gambling problem,” he said. The measure faces a long rulemaking process, including more rounds of public hearings and comments.
paragraphs.zh: 但基思·怀特（Keith Whyte）——美国问题赌博全国委员会前主任，现为行业机构和非营利组织提供咨询——表示，这项拟议修正案可能会无意中打击用户使用存款限额等工具的积极性。“我认为其隐含意思是，使用负责任博彩工具是赌博问题的标志，”他说。该措施还要经历漫长的规则制定程序，包括更多轮公开听证和意见征集。

vocab.meaning_zh: （在规模或强度上）加大、增强
vocab.example_en: Regulators have ramped up scrutiny of online betting apps.
vocab.example_zh: 监管机构已加大对在线博彩应用的审查力度。

vocab.meaning_zh: 严密审查、仔细审视（外刊高频，常与 come under / intensify 搭配）
vocab.example_en: The company came under intense scrutiny after the investigation.
vocab.example_zh: 调查之后，该公司受到严密审查。

vocab.meaning_zh: 护栏；（比喻）防护机制、限制措施
vocab.example_en: The industry says it has guardrails to protect vulnerable users.
vocab.example_zh: 业界称其设有保护脆弱用户的防护机制。

vocab.meaning_zh: 失控并不断恶化（spiral 原指螺旋式上升/下降）
vocab.example_en: Small losses can quickly spiral out of control.
vocab.example_zh: 小额亏损可能迅速失控、越滚越大。

vocab.meaning_zh: 授予、给予（正式用语，常与 on/upon 连用）
vocab.example_en: The app bestowed VIP status on the new user within days.
vocab.example_zh: 这款应用几天内就授予该新用户VIP身份。

vocab.meaning_zh: （美式用法）搁置、暂缓审议（议案、申请）——熟词僻义，注意英式英语中 table 反而有“提出”之意
vocab.example_en: The board tabled the renewal of the license.
vocab.example_zh: 委员会搁置了该牌照的续期。

vocab.meaning_zh: 选择加入、主动启用（与 opt out 相反）
vocab.example_en: Users can opt into tools that limit their deposit amounts.
vocab.example_zh: 用户可以主动启用限制存款金额的工具。

vocab.meaning_zh: 照亮；使（问题）变得清晰、凸显出来
vocab.example_en: The reporting illuminated a gap in the state's rules.
vocab.example_zh: 这组报道凸显了该州规则中的一处空白。

vocab.meaning_zh: 使失去动力、抑制……的积极性（incentive 的反向构词）
vocab.example_en: The rule could disincentivize users from setting limits.
vocab.example_zh: 这项规定可能会让用户不愿设置限额。

vocab.meaning_zh: （定期）沟通、汇报、联络
vocab.example_en: Regular check-ins with regulators are normal course of business.
vocab.example_zh: 与监管机构定期沟通属于正常业务。

sentences.en: The day after the Louisiana meeting, regulators in Ohio proposed an amendment to the state’s sports gaming rule that would bar companies like DraftKings from sending direct ads or marketing to bettors for 48 hours after they’d opted into responsible gaming tools or updated their current settings.
sentences.structure: 主干：regulators in Ohio proposed an amendment（主谓宾）。修饰：to the state’s sports gaming rule 是介词短语作定语，说明是哪部规则的修正案；that would bar ... 是定语从句修饰 amendment；从句内部 bar sb. from doing sth. 为固定搭配；for 48 hours 是时间状语；after they’d opted into ... or updated ... 是时间状语从句，用过去完成时强调“先启用、后打广告”的先后顺序。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句是典型的新闻长句：主干极短（俄亥俄监管者提出修正案），信息量全压在后置定语和状语上。翻译时中文宜拆成“提出一项修正案……将禁止……”的连动结构，避免把定语从句硬塞进“的”字短语里。

sentences.en: Those articles were the focus of an Oct. 15 meeting of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board, which, partly in response to the stories, tabled the renewal of DraftKings’ five-year license.
sentences.structure: 主干：Those articles were the focus（主系表）。修饰：of an Oct. 15 meeting of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board 层层介词短语限定 focus；which ... 是非限制性定语从句修饰 the board；从句中 partly in response to the stories 是插入的状语，插在主语 which 和谓语 tabled 之间。
sentences.analysis_zh: 注意 which 指代的是委员会而非会议；插入状语故意放在主谓之间，是为了让“回应报道”这一因果关系紧贴先行词。tabled 在此为美式“搁置”，若读成英式“提出”会完全误解整段。

sentences.en: But Keith Whyte, a former director of the National Council on Problem Gambling who now consults for industry and nonprofit groups, said the proposed amendment could unintentionally disincentivize users from using tools like deposit limits.
sentences.structure: 主干：Keith Whyte said (that) ...。修饰：a former director ... 是同位语，who now consults for ... 是定语从句，二者都后置修饰主语；宾语从句中 the proposed amendment 作主语，could disincentivize 作谓语，users 作宾语，from using tools like deposit limits 是介词短语说明“在哪方面失去动力”。
sentences.analysis_zh: 外刊介绍人物时惯用“姓名 + 同位语 + 定语从句”三件套，把身份、履历一次交代清楚，中文宜拆成破折号或“现任……的前主任”来处理。disincentivize sb. from doing 是理解本句的关键搭配，意为“使某人不愿做某事”。

background.title: 美国体育博彩的州级监管格局
background.text_zh: 2018年美国最高法院在 Murphy v. NCAA 案中推翻1992年《职业与业余体育保护法》，联邦层面禁止体育博彩的规定失效，各州可自行立法开放并设立监管机构。此后 DraftKings、FanDuel 等在线平台迅速扩张。因此，对博彩公司的牌照发放、广告投放、负责任博彩措施的监管权主要在州一级（如文中路易斯安那州博彩控制委员会、俄亥俄州赌场控制委员会），联邦议员则多以发函质询、推动立法的方式施压。文中提到的“预测市场”（prediction market）是近年另一类受关注的新型平台，常被批评与体育博彩界线模糊。

background.title: “负责任博彩”与问题赌博
background.text_zh: “负责任博彩”（responsible gaming）是博彩业的自律概念，通常包括存款限额、下注限额、时长提醒、冷静期（cool-off）、自我排除名单等工具，由用户自行设置。批评者认为，这类工具默认关闭、提示微弱、设置后又容易被营销推送抵消，实际效果有限。美国问题赌博全国委员会（National Council on Problem Gambling, NCPG）是推动相关研究与求助热线的非营利机构。文中路易斯安那州卫生官员所称“赌博障碍”（gambling disorder），是美国精神医学学会诊断手册中的正式诊断名称，取代了旧称“病理性赌博”。

title_en: ‘What we leave behind is not as important as how we’ve lived’: remembering actor Patrick Stewart
excerpt_en: Passing away this week at 86, Stewart will be remembered as actor, dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar, mutant professor, and distinguished Starfleet captain.
body_en: At the end of Star Trek: Generations (1994), surveying the wreckage of the crashed USS Enterprise he captained for nearly a decade, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) muses to his first officer, William Riker (Jonathan Frakes):
… time is a companion that goes with us on the journey, reminds us to cherish every moment, because it will never come again. What we leave behind is not as important as how we’ve lived.
Smiling, he quips to Riker, “After all, Number One, we’re only mortal.”

Passing away this week at 86 years old, we are sadly reminded of that mortality with the death of Sir Patrick Stewart: actor, dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar, mutant professor, and distinguished Starfleet captain.
From humble beginnings Born in Mirfield, England, in 1940, Stewart grew up poor during the worst days of the second world war.
He found his calling to theatre as a child, thanks to a keen-eyed English teacher and a copy of Shakespeare’s plays.
He left school at 15 to become a working actor in community theatre.
His extraordinary talent would lead to a stay at the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School, membership with the Royal Shakespeare Company, and a host of acclaimed theatre performances.
Despite the many screen roles for which Stewart would later be known, his Shakespearean roots are indelibly intertwined with almost every performance he gave.

They would also give him – and many of us – something to lighten the load of COVID lockdowns. Stewart used social media in 2020 to read the internet a Shakespearean sonnet each day, later turning his delightful orations into an audiobook.
For most, Stewart will best be remembered as a kaleidoscopic titan of film and television.
Beginning as a firefighter on the British soap opera Coronation Street in 1967, Stewart’s illustrious screen career spanned more than 50 years and a vast array of roles.

a flamboyant interior designer a stoic Atreides weapon master in a screen adaptation of the Dune books the irreverent king of England a foul-mouthed CIA deputy director an enigmatic cult leader, and a megalomaniacal egg-alien overlord. Two key roles From his storied body of work, two roles loom largest.

He was the telepathic mutant and academic Charles Xavier of the X-Men film series – a role he played for more than 25 years, including a posthumous appearance in Avengers: Doomsday (released this December).

As Professor X, Stewart embodied a beloved superhero with paternal warmth and secretive, calculating intellect. He was an empathetic leader of a team of extraordinary people who had been shunned, threatened and harmed by the world for their differences.

One cannot help but think this role enabled Stewart to channel much of his real-life allyship with marginalised queer communities and his support for survivors of domestic violence (which was based on his own childhood experiences).

In this role, Stewart acted alongside his long-time friend Sir Ian McKellen, who played the mutant antagonist and master of metal Magneto. Ironically, McKellen had once warned Stewart not to forsake the theatre for the screen, advising that a career in film and television would go nowhere.

Stewart and McKellen’s endearing friendship and acclaimed X-Men performances became the stuff of internet legend, particularly when McKellen officiated Stewart’s wedding to US singer Sunny Ozell in 2013.
Stewart’s work in Star Trek as Jean-Luc Picard – captain (later admiral) of the USS Enterprise – is equally revered.

As Stewart’s first major American television role, he took the captain’s chair in Star Trek: The Next Generation in 1987. He would eventually appear in seven seasons, four theatrical films, and the recent sequel series Star Trek: Picard.

Despite initial reservations – including an infamous on-set incident where he stoically told his rambunctious Next Generation colleagues that “ we are not here to have fun ” – Stewart later embraced the role of Picard. He will be remembered as one of Star Trek’s most acclaimed and legendary performers.
As Picard, Stewart created a potent role model in a franchise focused on an inclusive, utopian future.

enrich.title_zh: 「我们留下什么，不如我们如何度过一生」：缅怀演员帕特里克·斯图尔特
enrich.summary_zh: 本文是《对话》为英国演员帕特里克·斯图尔特去世所写的纪念文章。文章以他在《星际迷航》中关于时间与生死的台词开篇，回顾了他从战后贫困少年成长为皇家莎士比亚剧团演员的经历，并梳理了他最为人铭记的两个角色——《X战警》中的X教授与《星际迷航》中的皮卡德舰长，指出他的莎士比亚根基贯穿其表演生涯，最终塑造出一种包容性的榜样形象。

paragraphs.en: At the end of Star Trek: Generations (1994), surveying the wreckage of the crashed USS Enterprise he captained for nearly a decade, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) muses to his first officer, William Riker (Jonathan Frakes):
paragraphs.zh: 在《星际迷航：日换星移》（1994）的结尾，让-吕克·皮卡德（帕特里克·斯图尔特饰）望着他担任舰长近十年的“进取号”星舰坠毁后的残骸，向他的大副威廉·赖克（乔纳森·弗雷克斯饰）若有所思地说道：

paragraphs.en: … time is a companion that goes with us on the journey, reminds us to cherish every moment, because it will never come again. What we leave behind is not as important as how we’ve lived.
paragraphs.zh: “……时间是一位旅伴，与我们同行于旅途之中，提醒我们珍惜每一个瞬间，因为它一去不返。我们留下些什么，不如我们如何度过这一生来得重要。”

paragraphs.en: Smiling, he quips to Riker, “After all, Number One, we’re only mortal.”
paragraphs.zh: 他微笑着对赖克打趣道：“说到底，一号，我们终有一死。”

paragraphs.en: Passing away this week at 86 years old, we are sadly reminded of that mortality with the death of Sir Patrick Stewart: actor, dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar, mutant professor, and distinguished Starfleet captain.
paragraphs.zh: 本周，帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士以86岁高龄辞世，令我们悲伤地再次想起人终有一死：他是演员、剧作家、莎士比亚戏剧的典范、变种人教授，也是卓越的星际舰队舰长。

paragraphs.en: From humble beginnings Born in Mirfield, England, in 1940, Stewart grew up poor during the worst days of the second world war.
paragraphs.zh: 出身寒微　斯图尔特1940年出生于英格兰的米尔菲尔德，在第二次世界大战最艰难的岁月里于贫困中长大。

paragraphs.en: He found his calling to theatre as a child, thanks to a keen-eyed English teacher and a copy of Shakespeare’s plays.
paragraphs.zh: 他童年时便找到了自己对戏剧的志向，这要归功于一位目光敏锐的英语老师和一本莎士比亚戏剧集。

paragraphs.en: He left school at 15 to become a working actor in community theatre.
paragraphs.zh: 他15岁便离开学校，成为一名在社区剧院谋生的职业演员。

paragraphs.en: His extraordinary talent would lead to a stay at the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School, membership with the Royal Shakespeare Company, and a host of acclaimed theatre performances.
paragraphs.zh: 他非凡的才华使他得以进入布里斯托老维克戏剧学校学习、加入皇家莎士比亚剧团，并奉上一系列广受赞誉的舞台演出。

paragraphs.en: Despite the many screen roles for which Stewart would later be known, his Shakespearean roots are indelibly intertwined with almost every performance he gave.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管斯图尔特后来以众多银幕角色为人所知，但他的莎士比亚根基几乎与他每一次表演都不可磨灭地交织在一起。

paragraphs.en: They would also give him – and many of us – something to lighten the load of COVID lockdowns. Stewart used social media in 2020 to read the internet a Shakespearean sonnet each day, later turning his delightful orations into an audiobook.
paragraphs.zh: 这些根基也给了他、也给了我们许多人，一些足以减轻新冠疫情封锁期间重负的东西。2020年，斯图尔特借助社交媒体每天为网友朗读一首莎士比亚十四行诗，后来还把他那些令人愉悦的朗诵制作成了有声书。

paragraphs.en: For most, Stewart will best be remembered as a kaleidoscopic titan of film and television.
paragraphs.zh: 对大多数人而言，斯图尔特最令人铭记的身份是影视界一位千变万化的巨人。

paragraphs.en: Beginning as a firefighter on the British soap opera Coronation Street in 1967, Stewart’s illustrious screen career spanned more than 50 years and a vast array of roles.
paragraphs.zh: 从1967年在英国肥皂剧《加冕街》中饰演一名消防员起步，斯图尔特辉煌的银幕生涯横跨五十余年，涵盖了大量各不相同的角色。

paragraphs.en: a flamboyant interior designer a stoic Atreides weapon master in a screen adaptation of the Dune books the irreverent king of England a foul-mouthed CIA deputy director an enigmatic cult leader, and a megalomaniacal egg-alien overlord. Two key roles From his storied body of work, two roles loom largest.
paragraphs.zh: 一位张扬浮夸的室内设计师；《沙丘》系列影视改编中一位坚忍的阿崔迪家族武器大师；一位不羁的英格兰国王；一位满口脏话的中央情报局副局长；一位神秘的邪教领袖；以及一位自大狂般的蛋形外星霸主。两个关键角色　在他传奇般的众多作品中，有两个角色最为突出。

paragraphs.en: He was the telepathic mutant and academic Charles Xavier of the X-Men film series – a role he played for more than 25 years, including a posthumous appearance in Avengers: Doomsday (released this December).
paragraphs.zh: 他是《X战警》系列中那位有心灵感应能力的变种人、学者查尔斯·泽维尔——这个角色他演了超过25年，包括在《复仇者联盟：毁灭日》（今年12月上映）中以身后影像登场。

paragraphs.en: As Professor X, Stewart embodied a beloved superhero with paternal warmth and secretive, calculating intellect. He was an empathetic leader of a team of extraordinary people who had been shunned, threatened and harmed by the world for their differences.
paragraphs.zh: 作为X教授，斯图尔特塑造了一位深受喜爱的超级英雄，兼具慈父般的温暖与深藏不露、精于算计的智慧。他是一支非凡团队中富有同理心的领袖，这支团队的成员因其与众不同而被世人排斥、威胁和伤害。

paragraphs.en: One cannot help but think this role enabled Stewart to channel much of his real-life allyship with marginalised queer communities and his support for survivors of domestic violence (which was based on his own childhood experiences).
paragraphs.zh: 人们不禁会想，正是这个角色让斯图尔特得以倾注他在现实生活中对边缘化酷儿群体的声援，以及他对家庭暴力幸存者的支持（这份支持源自他自己的童年经历）。

paragraphs.en: In this role, Stewart acted alongside his long-time friend Sir Ian McKellen, who played the mutant antagonist and master of metal Magneto. Ironically, McKellen had once warned Stewart not to forsake the theatre for the screen, advising that a career in film and television would go nowhere.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个角色中，斯图尔特与他多年的好友伊恩·麦克莱恩爵士同台演出，后者饰演变种人反派、金属之主万磁王。颇具讽刺意味的是，麦克莱恩曾告诫斯图尔特不要为了银幕而舍弃戏剧，还劝他说电影电视这条路走不通。

paragraphs.en: Stewart and McKellen’s endearing friendship and acclaimed X-Men performances became the stuff of internet legend, particularly when McKellen officiated Stewart’s wedding to US singer Sunny Ozell in 2013.
paragraphs.zh: 斯图尔特与麦克莱恩之间惹人喜爱的友谊以及广受赞誉的《X战警》表演，成了网络上的传奇谈资，尤其是2013年麦克莱恩为斯图尔特与美国歌手桑妮·奥泽尔的婚礼主持仪式那一次。

paragraphs.en: Stewart’s work in Star Trek as Jean-Luc Picard – captain (later admiral) of the USS Enterprise – is equally revered.
paragraphs.zh: 斯图尔特在《星际迷航》中饰演的让-吕克·皮卡德——进取号星舰的舰长（后为上将）——同样备受尊崇。

paragraphs.en: As Stewart’s first major American television role, he took the captain’s chair in Star Trek: The Next Generation in 1987. He would eventually appear in seven seasons, four theatrical films, and the recent sequel series Star Trek: Picard.
paragraphs.zh: 作为斯图尔特首个重要的美国电视角色，他于1987年在《星际迷航：下一代》中坐上了舰长之位。他最终出演了七季剧集、四部院线电影，以及近年的续作剧集《星际迷航：皮卡德》。

paragraphs.en: Despite initial reservations – including an infamous on-set incident where he stoically told his rambunctious Next Generation colleagues that “ we are not here to have fun ” – Stewart later embraced the role of Picard. He will be remembered as one of Star Trek’s most acclaimed and legendary performers.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管起初他心存保留——其中还包括一次臭名昭著的片场事件：他面不改色地告诫他那些闹腾的《下一代》同僚，“我们不是来玩的”——但斯图尔特后来还是接纳了皮卡德这个角色。他将作为《星际迷航》中最受赞誉、最具传奇色彩的演员之一而被铭记。

paragraphs.en: As Picard, Stewart created a potent role model in a franchise focused on an inclusive, utopian future.
paragraphs.zh: 作为皮卡德，斯图尔特在一个聚焦包容性乌托邦未来的系列作品中，塑造出了一个极具感召力的榜样。

vocab.meaning_zh: 打趣地说，俏皮地说（常指在严肃场合中说出轻松的话）
vocab.example_en: “Well, that went well,” she quipped as the meeting collapsed.
vocab.example_zh: 会议谈崩时，她打趣道：“嗯，进展顺利。”

vocab.meaning_zh: 剧作家；（剧团的）戏剧顾问、戏剧构作
vocab.example_en: He worked as a dramaturge at the national theatre before turning to directing.
vocab.example_zh: 在转行做导演之前，他在国家剧院担任戏剧构作。

vocab.meaning_zh: 典范，楷模（常指某一品质或某类人的典型代表）
vocab.example_en: She is regarded as an exemplar of British stage acting.
vocab.example_zh: 她被视作英国舞台表演的典范。

vocab.meaning_zh: 千变万化的，纷繁多样的（形容种类极多、不断变换）
vocab.example_en: His kaleidoscopic career ranged from soap opera to Shakespeare.
vocab.example_zh: 他从肥皂剧到莎士比亚戏剧的职业生涯，丰富多变、光怪陆离。

vocab.meaning_zh: 辉煌的，声名显赫的（多修饰生涯、履历、前辈）
vocab.example_en: She enjoyed an illustrious career spanning four decades.
vocab.example_zh: 她拥有横跨四十年的辉煌职业生涯。

vocab.meaning_zh: 坚忍的，不动声色的（面对痛苦或情绪波动不轻易外露）
vocab.example_en: He remained stoic in the face of relentless criticism.
vocab.example_zh: 面对持续不断的批评，他始终不动声色。

vocab.meaning_zh: 喧闹的，闹腾难管的（多形容人或场面精力过剩、吵闹）
vocab.example_en: The rambunctious cast kept the director on his toes.
vocab.example_zh: 这帮闹腾的演员让导演一刻不得清闲。

vocab.meaning_zh: 不可磨灭地，难以忘怀地（源自 indelible，指痕迹擦不掉）
vocab.example_en: The war left an indelible mark on his generation.
vocab.example_zh: 那场战争在他那一代人身上留下了不可磨灭的印记。

vocab.meaning_zh: （对边缘群体的）声援与同盟关系（近年欧美公共话语中的高频词）
vocab.example_en: The company promotes allyship with LGBTQ+ employees.
vocab.example_zh: 该公司倡导对LGBTQ+员工的支持与结盟。

vocab.meaning_zh: 崇敬，尊崇（语气强于 respect，多用于人物、传统）
vocab.example_en: The conductor is revered by musicians around the world.
vocab.example_zh: 这位指挥家受到世界各地音乐家的崇敬。

sentences.en: At the end of Star Trek: Generations (1994), surveying the wreckage of the crashed USS Enterprise he captained for nearly a decade, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) muses to his first officer, William Riker (Jonathan Frakes):
sentences.structure: 主干：Jean-Luc Picard muses to his first officer, William Riker（主谓+间接宾语）。修饰：At the end of… 为时间状语；surveying the wreckage of the crashed USS Enterprise 为现在分词短语作伴随状语，逻辑主语是 Picard；he captained for nearly a decade 是省略了关系代词 that/which 的定语从句，修饰 USS Enterprise。
sentences.analysis_zh: 整句把一个动作拆成“看残骸”与“发感慨”两层，主干其实只有一个动词 muses，前面所有内容都是“铺垫”。真正的难点是修饰层级：crashed 修饰 Enterprise，he captained… 又修饰 Enterprise，读的时候要把“他当了近十年舰长的那艘进取号”作为整体宾语中心词。这种“主句前挂一大串分词+定语从句”的写法是英文人物特写常用的开篇手法，先给画面、再给人物、最后才给言语。

sentences.en: Passing away this week at 86 years old, we are sadly reminded of that mortality with the death of Sir Patrick Stewart: actor, dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar, mutant professor, and distinguished Starfleet captain.
sentences.structure: 主干：we are reminded of that mortality。修饰：Passing away this week at 86 years old 为现在分词短语作状语，逻辑主语应是 Stewart，与主句主语 we 不一致，属“悬垂分词”；with the death of Sir Patrick Stewart 为原因状语；冒号后是一串名词短语作 Stewart 的同位语。
sentences.analysis_zh: 悬垂分词（dangling participle）在严格的语法书里算病句，因为“去世”的不能是 we；但在新闻与专栏写作中很常见，靠上下文自然消歧。冒号后的同位语罗列是本文的一个特色：用五个身份标签一口气概括其一生，从舞台（dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar）到银幕（mutant professor）再到科幻经典（Starfleet captain），顺序本身就是一种评价。

sentences.en: He was an empathetic leader of a team of extraordinary people who had been shunned, threatened and harmed by the world for their differences.
sentences.structure: 主干：He was an empathetic leader。修饰：of a team of extraordinary people 为介词短语修饰 leader；who had been shunned, threatened and harmed by the world 为定语从句修饰 people，三个过去分词构成排比；for their differences 为原因状语，说明被排斥的理由。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句话真正的主语其实是“the world”——三个被动动词把施害者放在 by 之后，读起来是对主流社会的控诉。“for their differences”放在句末，是英语里常见的“尾重”安排：把最关键的语义落在最后，同时与全文“包容”的主题呼应。

background.title: 从皇家莎士比亚剧团到好莱坞：英国演员的双轨传统
background.text_zh: 英国表演界长期存在舞台与银幕互通的传统。皇家莎士比亚剧团（Royal Shakespeare Company，RSC）以斯特拉特福为基地，是全球最具权威的莎剧演出团体之一；布里斯托老维克戏剧学校（Bristol Old Vic Theatre School）也是英国老牌戏剧院校，出了不少知名演员。许多英国演员先在剧院打磨多年，再进入影视，所以在英国语境里“莎剧功底”常被当作演技背书。文中写到麦克莱恩劝斯图尔特“别为银幕放弃戏剧”，正是这一圈子的典型玩笑——两人后来都因商业大片在全球走红，这句话因此显得格外反讽。

background.title: “Number One”与《星际迷航》的乌托邦设定
background.text_zh: “Number One”是《星际迷航》中舰长对大副（副舰长）的昵称，源自航海传统，指“一号人物/副手”，《下一代》里 Picard 对 Riker 的这句称呼已成粉丝梗。1966年开播的《星际迷航》以星际舰队（Starfleet）和进取号（USS Enterprise，文中 USS 指“合众国星舰”）为核心设定，描绘了一个种族、性别、物种平等的未来社会，这正是文章结尾强调“包容性乌托邦”的原因。《下一代》（1987—1994）是该系列第二部主要剧集，斯图尔特主演七季，此后又拍了四部院线电影。

title_en: Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents
excerpt_en: The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: ProPublica Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens. Since the start of this Trump administration, we’ve watched those warnings come true.

So we have once again done what the government won’t: We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.
Read our earlier reporting on U.S. citizens being detained.

We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it. We asked the Department of Homeland Security about each incident, and we searched for any federal criminal charges that were brought in relation to each incident. (DHS has repeatedly said it is not arresting U.S. citizens.)

Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount. Below, we’re showing you every case we found — the reality that the administration denies — along with the receipts. Read more about how we reported this project.
The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.

enrich.title_zh: ProPublica 梳理 500 多起美国公民遭移民执法人员拘留的案例
enrich.summary_zh: ProPublica 指出，专家长期警告移民大规模抓捕行动终将同时侵蚀移民与美国公民的权利，而这一警告在特朗普本届任期内已然成真。该机构通过检索社交媒体、法庭记录与地方媒体，交叉核实至少两个信源，统计出从就职日到 2026 年 10 月 21 日期间 500 多起移民执法人员拘留美国公民的案例。由于政府本身不追踪这类案件，这一数字几乎肯定被低估。

paragraphs.en: ProPublica Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens. Since the start of this Trump administration, we’ve watched those warnings come true.
paragraphs.zh: ProPublica 长期以来，专家们一直警告说，移民大规模抓捕行动不可避免地不仅会侵蚀移民的权利，也会侵蚀美国公民的权利。自特朗普本届政府上任以来，我们眼看着这些警告一一变成了现实。

paragraphs.en: So we have once again done what the government won’t: We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 于是，我们再一次做了政府不愿做的事：把本届政府任内我们所能找到的每一例移民执法人员据报拘留美国公民的案件都逐一统计、编目——从总统就职日到 2026 年 10 月 21 日，共 500 多例。

paragraphs.en: Read our earlier reporting on U.S. citizens being detained.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读我们此前关于美国公民被拘留的报道。

paragraphs.en: We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it. We asked the Department of Homeland Security about each incident, and we searched for any federal criminal charges that were brought in relation to each incident. (DHS has repeatedly said it is not arresting U.S. citizens.)
paragraphs.zh: 我们的清单是通过检索社交媒体、法庭记录和地方媒体汇编而成的，并且只有在至少找到两个信源的情况下，我们才会把一起事件列入其中。我们就每一起事件向国土安全部提出了询问，并查询了与每起事件相关的任何联邦刑事指控。（国土安全部已多次表示，该部门并未逮捕美国公民。）

paragraphs.en: Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount. Below, we’re showing you every case we found — the reality that the administration denies — along with the receipts. Read more about how we reported this project.
paragraphs.zh: 由于政府本身并不追踪这类案件，我们的清单几乎可以肯定少于实际数量。下面，我们列出我们找到的每一起案例——也就是本届政府所否认的那个现实——并附上证据。进一步了解我们是如何完成这项报道的。

paragraphs.en: The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.
paragraphs.zh: 《检索 500 多起美国公民遭移民执法人员拘留案例》一文首发于 ProPublica。

vocab.meaning_zh: （警方或执法部门的）大规模搜捕行动、拉网式清查（本义为“拖网”）
vocab.example_en: The city launched a dragnet across the neighborhood after the shooting.
vocab.example_zh: 枪击事件发生后，该市在这个街区展开了大规模搜捕。

vocab.meaning_zh: （权利、价值等的）逐步削弱、侵蚀
vocab.example_en: Critics say the new law will lead to the erosion of press freedom.
vocab.example_zh: 批评者称，这项新法律将导致新闻自由受到侵蚀。

vocab.meaning_zh: 统计、清点（数量）；n. 计数、 tally
vocab.example_en: Officials are still tallying the votes from Tuesday's election.
vocab.example_zh: 官员们仍在统计周二选举的选票。

vocab.meaning_zh: （系统地）编目、分类记录（英式拼写为 catalogue）
vocab.example_en: The report catalogs every documented case of police misconduct.
vocab.example_zh: 这份报告把每一例有据可查的警察不当行为都编目记录在案。

vocab.meaning_zh: （彻底地）搜索、翻查
vocab.example_en: Researchers scoured archives for any mention of the family.
vocab.example_zh: 研究人员翻遍档案，寻找任何提到这个家族的记录。

vocab.meaning_zh: 统计偏低、漏计的数量
vocab.example_en: Advocates say the official figures are a serious undercount.
vocab.example_zh: 维权人士称，官方数字存在严重的漏计。

vocab.meaning_zh: （口语）证据、凭据（源自“收据”，社交媒体常用语，意为“拿得出证据”）
vocab.example_en: She brought the receipts: emails, screenshots and bank records.
vocab.example_zh: 她拿出了证据：邮件、截图和银行记录。

vocab.meaning_zh: 拘留、扣押（此处指移民执法中的短暂羁押）
vocab.example_en: He was detained at the airport for several hours.
vocab.example_zh: 他在机场被扣留了几个小时。

vocab.meaning_zh: （美国总统）就职日，即 1 月 20 日；本文用它作为新政府任期的起点
vocab.example_en: The order was signed hours after Inauguration Day.
vocab.example_zh: 这项行政令在就职日数小时后即被签署。

sentences.en: Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens.
sentences.structure: 主干：Experts（主）have warned（谓）that…（宾语从句）。从句主干：immigration dragnets（主）will result（谓）in the erosion of rights（介词宾语）。修饰：not only … but also … 连接两个并列的介词短语 in the erosion of rights for immigrants 与 (in the erosion of rights) for citizens，后者承前省略。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句话是全篇的论点句。用 not only … but also 把“移民的权利”和“公民的权利”并列，是修辞上的递进：读者原以为抓捕行动只伤害外来者，文章强调最终会波及本国公民。注意 but also 后面只是一个 for citizens，省略了前面的 in the erosion of rights，阅读时要自行补全，否则容易读不通。

sentences.en: We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it.
sentences.structure: 由 and 连接的两个并列分句。前一分句：We（主）compiled（谓）our list（宾），by scouring … 为方式状语。后一分句：we（主）included（谓）an incident（宾），only if … 引导条件状语从句，其中 for it 是 sources 的后置定语。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这是新闻调查报道里交代方法论的典型句式：先说做了什么（compiled），再用 by doing 说明怎么做的，最后用 only if 交代取舍标准。only if 是“只有在……才”，比 if 语气强得多，等于向读者承诺：证据不足的案例一律不收录。两个信源的门槛是调查报道中常见的交叉验证标准。

sentences.en: Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount.
sentences.structure: 主干：our list（主）is（系）an undercount（表）。Since 引导原因状语从句（此处表原因，意为“由于”），almost certainly 为程度状语修饰整个判断。
sentences.analysis_zh: 先用 Since 从句把责任推给政府——“不是我们没找全，是官方根本不统计”；再用 almost certainly 这种留有余地的副词，避免把话说死。这种“承认局限反而增强可信度”的写法，是数据类调查报道的常见策略：既说明了数据的保守性，也暗示真实数字只会更大。

background.title: ProPublica 是什么机构
background.text_zh: ProPublica 是一家美国非营利性调查新闻编辑部，2007 年成立，以长篇调查报道著称，多次获得普利策奖。它不设付费墙，稿件常被其他媒体免费转载，因此文中会出现“Read our earlier reporting”“Read more about how we reported this project”这类指向站内相关报道和“方法论说明”的链接句——这是 ProPublica 的固定做法：把采访方法、数据来源单独写成一篇说明，供读者核查。

background.title: 国土安全部与移民执法体系
background.text_zh: 美国国土安全部（Department of Homeland Security, DHS）是 2001 年“9·11”后组建的内阁级部门，下属的移民与海关执法局（ICE）和海关与边境保护局（CBP）负责境内移民执法与边境拘押。文中的“immigration agent”指的就是这类执法人员。历史上，大规模身份清查（如工作场所突击检查）常被批评会连带波及在场的美国公民和合法居民，这正是文中“dragnet（拉网）”一词所暗示的执法模式。

title_en: How porn became so extreme – and how it’s shaping the sex lives of young people
excerpt_en: Extreme pornography has become readily available on mainstream porn sites. Clare McGlynn explains what this is doing to the sex lives of young people.
body_en: A few years ago, the singer Billie Eilish opened up on the Howard Stern Show about how she began watching porn around age 11.
“I’m so angry that porn is so loved, and I’m so angry at myself for thinking that it was ok,” she said.

Eilish became addicted to porn, and it led to problems. “The first few times I had sex, I was not saying no to things that were not good,” she said. She had nightmares because the content she was watching was so violent and abusive.

Online porn is a multi-million dollar business, driven by algorithms designed to keep people clicking for more. These algorithms push more and more extreme content, often for free, to people who didn’t go searching for it. This can include strangulation, exploitation or incest porn, that’s often misogynistic and racist too.

“If you take incest and strangulation, we can look at content studies from the 1980s, for example, when there was hardly any of that material,” Clare McGlynn, professor of law at Durham University in the UK, tells The Conversation Weekly podcast. “Today both incest and strangulation becomes mainstream.”

In the UK, the government will ban the possession and publication of incest and strangulation porn from early November. McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.
McGlynn, who has written a recent book about the rise of extreme porn, says large online porn platforms are pushing people towards more and more extreme content.

Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.
McGlynn says an abundance of extreme and violent porn is shaping the sex lives of young people, and it can lead to an increased risk of problematic behaviour.

There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys. And there’s studies in Australia and the US … showing that the more porn they watch, the more strangulation they see, and then the more they identify that they act out the strangulation.

enrich.title_zh: 色情内容如何变得如此极端——以及它如何塑造年轻人的性生活
enrich.summary_zh: 文章以歌手比莉·艾利什自述11岁起沉迷色情内容为引子，采访英国杜伦大学法学教授麦格琳，指出大型色情平台靠算法用免费、越来越极端的内容留住用户，使乱伦、扼颈等题材逐渐“主流化”；研究显示高频率观看与青少年男孩的问题性行为相关，英国将从11月初起禁止此类内容的持有与发布。

paragraphs.en: A few years ago, the singer Billie Eilish opened up on the Howard Stern Show about how she began watching porn around age 11.
paragraphs.zh: 几年前，歌手比莉·艾利什（Billie Eilish）在《霍华德·斯特恩秀》节目中坦承，她大约在11岁时开始看色情内容。

paragraphs.en: “I’m so angry that porn is so loved, and I’m so angry at myself for thinking that it was ok,” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “我很愤怒，色情内容竟然如此受欢迎；我也很生自己的气，因为我曾经觉得这没什么。”她说。

paragraphs.en: Eilish became addicted to porn, and it led to problems. “The first few times I had sex, I was not saying no to things that were not good,” she said. She had nightmares because the content she was watching was so violent and abusive.
paragraphs.zh: 艾利什对色情内容上了瘾，并因此出了问题。“最初几次发生性关系时，对那些并不好的事情，我没有说‘不’。”她说。她做噩梦，因为她看的内容如此暴力、充满凌虐。

paragraphs.en: Online porn is a multi-million dollar business, driven by algorithms designed to keep people clicking for more. These algorithms push more and more extreme content, often for free, to people who didn’t go searching for it. This can include strangulation, exploitation or incest porn, that’s often misogynistic and racist too.
paragraphs.zh: 网络色情是一门价值数百万美元的生意，其驱动力是旨在让人不断点击、欲罢不能的算法。这些算法把越来越极端的内容推送给那些根本没有去搜索它们的人，而且常常是免费的。这类内容可能包括扼颈、剥削或乱伦题材的色情片，其中往往还带有厌女与种族主义色彩。

paragraphs.en: “If you take incest and strangulation, we can look at content studies from the 1980s, for example, when there was hardly any of that material,” Clare McGlynn, professor of law at Durham University in the UK, tells The Conversation Weekly podcast. “Today both incest and strangulation becomes mainstream.”
paragraphs.zh: “以乱伦和扼颈为例，我们可以看看20世纪80年代的内容研究——那时这类材料几乎不存在，”英国杜伦大学法学教授克莱尔·麦格琳（Clare McGlynn）对《对话周刊》播客说，“而今天，乱伦和扼颈都成了主流。”

paragraphs.en: In the UK, the government will ban the possession and publication of incest and strangulation porn from early November. McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.
paragraphs.zh: 在英国，政府将从11月初起禁止持有和发布乱伦与扼颈题材的色情内容。麦格琳曾与民间社会组织合作推动对极端内容的监管，她表示这是“巨大的一步”，传递出“将性暴力正常化”危害何在的信号。

paragraphs.en: McGlynn, who has written a recent book about the rise of extreme porn, says large online porn platforms are pushing people towards more and more extreme content.
paragraphs.zh: 麦格琳 recently 出版了一本关于极端色情内容兴起的书，她说，大型网络色情平台正在把人推向越来越极端的内容。

paragraphs.en: Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.
paragraphs.zh: 它们的商业模式就是让你保持参与。它们希望我们在平台上停留尽可能长的时间，而做到这一点的方法就是不断喂给你内容——不一定是你要找的东西，还包括那些越极端、越能制造对立、越令人震惊的内容……不幸的是，这似乎正是我们某种原始本能所追逐的东西，也正是真正能抓住我们、让我们不断搜索下去的东西。

paragraphs.en: McGlynn says an abundance of extreme and violent porn is shaping the sex lives of young people, and it can lead to an increased risk of problematic behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 麦格琳说，大量极端、暴力的色情内容正在塑造年轻人的性生活，并可能提高出现有问题行为的风险。

paragraphs.en: There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys. And there’s studies in Australia and the US … showing that the more porn they watch, the more strangulation they see, and then the more they identify that they act out the strangulation.
paragraphs.zh: 有一项研究追踪了1.6万名年轻人，结果显示，大量观看色情内容——尤其是在年纪很小的时候——是十几岁男孩出现有问题性行为的一个重要风险因素。澳大利亚和美国的研究则显示……他们看的色情内容越多，看到的扼颈场面就越多，随后他们也越多地承认自己真的把扼颈付诸实施。

background.title: 英国的极端色情立法
background.text_zh: 英国1995年《刑事司法与公共秩序法》第63条早已禁止所谓“极端色情图像”，主要针对涉及生命威胁、严重伤害等情节的性内容，但乱伦题材以及双方“自愿”性行为中的扼颈场面长期处于灰色地带。随着网络平台让这类内容变得随手可得，民间社会组织多年游说，要求把它正式列为违禁内容。文章说的“从11月初起禁止持有和发布”，就是这一监管收紧的结果。理解这一点，才能明白麦格琳为何把它称为“巨大的一步”——法律的着力点不只是个别视频，而是这类内容在文化上被视为“正常”的过程。

title_en: Detroit Could Block Billionaire-Owned Concrete Plant From Further Neighborhood Expansion
excerpt_en: The post Detroit Could Block Billionaire-Owned Concrete Plant From Further Neighborhood Expansion appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: The Kronos concrete mixing plant overlooks the Cadillac Heights neighborhood in Detroit. Sarahbeth Maney/ProPublica After years of community opposition, Detroit city officials have taken steps to stop a concrete mixing facility from further expanding into a residential neighborhood.

City Council members, acting on a recommendation last week from planning officials, will soon consider a rezoning measure that would restrict industrial activity at the site of the Kronos concrete plant and surrounding area. The concrete facility at its current size could stay and continue to operate as normal.

The planning recommendation comes after a BridgeDetroit and ProPublica investigation this year revealed how city officials helped Crown Enterprises, a real estate company owned by Detroit’s wealthy Moroun family, obtain property in Cadillac Heights and then provided latitude when its Kronos facility violated environmental laws. Residents have been filing complaints and protesting Kronos for years, frustrated by the dust, noise and other issues created by the concrete operation.

Left in the Dust: How a Billionaire-Owned Concrete Plant Took Over a Detroit Community The City Planning Commission voted Oct. 22 to recommend a change to some of the zoning in the neighborhood from heavy to light industrial, which allows buildings such as warehouses but excludes facilities like concrete plants. The commission also recommended that other lots be zoned for residential and commercial purposes. Earlier this month, the commissioners unanimously voted to exclude industrial zoning in the area adjacent to Kronos, but they stepped back from that last week.

Sharon Buttry, who helped organize residents to protest against the Kronos plant, said she is glad the lots would be rezoned but was disappointed that the earlier recommendation, which was more pedestrian- and transit-friendly, didn’t stand.
Buttry said she fears that the latest zoning recommendation would make it easier for Crown to expand eventually. “We still want them to shut down or move,” she said.
The zoning plan was revisited at the request of City Planning Commissioner Fred Russell Jr., who said the adjustment would create a buffer between residents and the existing concrete plant.
The City Council, which will ultimately decide on the rezoning, has scheduled a public hearing for Nov. 19.

Over the last seven years, Crown has obtained dozens of parcels in Cadillac Heights — some through a land deal with the city in 2019 and others after residents sold their parcels and left. In all, the company now owns more than 160 lots in the neighborhood, most of which are barren.

How a 2019 Land-Swap Deal Accelerated the Morouns’ Foothold The Moroun family spent decades, from 1966 to 2018, records show, gradually acquiring lots in Cadillac Heights through their various companies, eventually putting the parcels all under the ownership of Crown Enterprises. A May 2019 deal with the city of Detroit allowed Crown to acquire dozens of additional parcels during the next seven years.

Note: Sale dates for 19 parcels could not be identified, but records show Crown owned them as of June. Sources: City of Detroit, Detroit’s Office of the Assessor, Wayne County Register of Deeds, Detroit City Council. Chris Alcantara/ProPublica In a letter to Detroit officials in mid-September and Oct. 22, a law firm representing Crown threatened legal action if city officials change the zoning, arguing that doing so would devalue the property and create uncertainty about future development.

Attorney Melvin Butch Hollowell also said if the rezoning goes through, the city would be backtracking on its commitment to support Crown’s development in Cadillac Heights. Crown obtained the land there in exchange for the company swapping property in another part of the city, which allowed automaker Stellantis to open the first new car plant in Detroit in three decades.

City officials have said they didn’t know Crown’s plans included a concrete facility. Crown did not present a specific plan at the time of the land transfer. But after the concrete plant opened, the city in 2022 signed a first-of-its-kind agreement with Crown that gave the company time to fix issues before being penalized. The agreement has allowed the company to avoid fines on several occasions, the news organizations have documented.

In response to questions from BridgeDetroit and ProPublica, a Crown spokesperson said the company has invested more than $10 million to develop the concrete operation based “on the City’s promises and actions of approving our plans for this facility.”
“The property was traded to us for the express purpose of redevelopment,” the spokesperson, Kenneth Dobson, wrote.

Dobson said that if the zoning changes, the company will not make the improvements it has promised, including new landscaping and sidewalks. He claimed the improvements would not be allowed under the new zoning and that they also wouldn’t be a sound business decision. City planning staff, however, said the company can still make the improvements.

The neighborhood surrounding Kronos has been zoned to allow heavy industry since the 1940s, when a rail line operated there. Before the concrete operation, the land was occupied by a trucking depot for decades.

Despite the zoning designation, the neighborhood attracted working-class families who lived in modest single-family houses. Buddy’s Pizza, famous as the birthplace of Detroit-style pizza, was founded there and drew crowds from across the city.

The City Planning Commission’s votes this month were four years in the making and part of a broader evaluation of land near the proposed Joe Louis Greenway, a walking and biking trail that will traverse the city and is already under construction.

Chris Alcantara/ProPublica In a letter to Detroit officials in mid-September and Oct. 22, a law firm representing Crown threatened legal action if city officials change the zoning, arguing that doing so would devalue the property and create uncertainty about future development.

He claimed the improvements would not be allowed under the new zoning and that they also wouldn’t be a sound business decision. paragraphs.zh: Kronos 周边社区自 20 世纪 40 年代起就被划为允许重工业的用地，当时那里有一条铁路线在运营。在混凝土业务进驻之前，这片土地曾长期被一家卡车运输场站占用。

paragraphs.en: Despite the zoning designation, the neighborhood attracted working-class families who lived in modest single-family houses. Buddy’s Pizza, famous as the birthplace of Detroit-style pizza, was founded there and drew crowds from across the city.

paragraphs.en: The City Planning Commission’s votes this month were four years in the making and part of a broader evaluation of land near the proposed Joe Louis Greenway, a walking and biking trail that will traverse the city and is already under construction.

sentences.en: The planning recommendation comes after a BridgeDetroit and ProPublica investigation this year revealed how city officials helped Crown Enterprises, a real estate company owned by Detroit’s wealthy Moroun family, obtain property in Cadillac Heights and then provided latitude when its Kronos facility violated environmental laws.
sentences.structure: 主干：The planning recommendation comes after an investigation（主句） / 修饰：this year 修饰 investigation；revealed 后接 how 引导的宾语从句；a real estate company owned by… 是 Crown Enterprises 的同位语；when its Kronos facility violated environmental laws 是宾语从句内的时间状语从句
sentences.analysis_zh: 主句只有“建议是在调查之后到来”这一层意思，信息重心全落在 after 引导的时间状语里。作者把调查内容塞进一个 how 从句，用“帮助拿地 + 违法时给自由”两个动作并列，一句话交代了整篇报道的核心指控。同位语用过去分词 owned by 后置，既解释了 Crown 是谁，又点明其与莫朗家族的关系，为后文的利益关联埋线。翻译时宜拆成“揭露：……，而……”，保持两个动作的并列张力。

sentences.en: City Council members, acting on a recommendation last week from planning officials, will soon consider a rezoning measure that would restrict industrial activity at the site of the Kronos concrete plant and surrounding area.
sentences.structure: 主干：City Council members will soon consider a rezoning measure / 修饰：acting on a recommendation… 为现在分词短语作状语，说明依据；that would restrict… 为定语从句修饰 measure；at the site of… and surrounding area 为地点状语
sentences.analysis_zh: 主语和谓语被一个较长的分词状语隔开，这是英文新闻句的典型写法：先点明动作的依据，再交代动作本身。定语从句用 would 而非 will，是虚拟/推测语气，因为议案尚未通过，只表示“将会产生的效果”。restrict industrial activity 是全句的关键动词短语，正是“限制扩张”的法律落点。

sentences.en: Attorney Melvin Butch Hollowell also said if the rezoning goes through, the city would be backtracking on its commitment to support Crown’s development in Cadillac Heights.
sentences.structure: 主干：Attorney Melvin Butch Hollowell also said + 宾语从句 / 宾语从句内部：if the rezoning goes through（条件状语从句）+ the city would be backtracking on its commitment / 修饰：to support Crown’s development in Cadillac Heights 为不定式短语修饰 commitment
sentences.analysis_zh: said 后面省略了 that，直接跟宾语从句；从句本身是“条件 + 主句”结构。goes through 用一般现在时表将来，是条件句的常规用法；主句用 would be backtracking 进行时，强调“将处于一种出尔反尔的状态”，比 would backtrack 更有画面感。commitment to 中的 to 是介词，故后接动名词性名词 development，而非不定式。

background.title: 美国的区划（zoning）制度
background.text_zh: 美国城市通过“区划”规定每块地允许的用途与建筑强度，常见分类包括住宅、商业、轻工业、重工业等。用地性质一旦确定，业主只能在其范围内开发；改变性质须经规划委员会建议、市议会表决，并通常要举行公开听证，业主可提出异议甚至诉讼。因此，把某片区从“重工业”改为“轻工业”，实质就是禁止新建混凝土搅拌站这类重污染设施，而仓库等仍可建设。这也是本案双方围绕“重新区划是否等于变相征收、是否使地产贬值”展开法律博弈的原因。

background.title: 莫朗家族、Crown Enterprises 与 Stellantis 工厂
background.text_zh: 莫朗家族（Moroun family）是底特律最知名的地产富豪家族之一，长期拥有连接底特律与加拿大温莎的大使桥（Ambassador Bridge），以强硬维权和大量持有市中心周边地块著称。Crown Enterprises 是其旗下房地产公司。2019 年的土地置换中，Crown 交出城市另一处土地，使 Stellantis（原菲亚特克莱斯勒，旗下有 Jeep 等品牌）得以在该处建设底特律三十年来首座新整车厂，而 Crown 则获得 Cadillac Heights 的多块土地。这一段交易背景解释了市政府为何在道义与法律上都对 Crown 负有“支持再开发”的承诺。

title_en: Top U.S. Health Official Backed a Medication Policy Shift That Benefited a Company She Has Stock In
excerpt_en: The post Top U.S. Health Official Backed a Medication Policy Shift That Benefited a Company She Has Stock In appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: Alicia Jackson, director of the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health, speaks at an event earlier this year. Photo illustration by ProPublica. Photo by Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images. Last November, the Department of Health and Human Services announced the elimination of “black box” warnings on hormone replacement therapies, aiming to reverse nearly two decades of stigma surrounding a key treatment for menopause symptoms.

Among the officials at a press conference about the decision was Alicia Jackson, director of a federal health agency that invests taxpayer money in medical technology and research. As Jackson stood behind a lectern adorned with the HHS logo, she praised the new policy, calling it a victory for women and science.

“Today we have the opportunity to add up to a decade of healthy years to the life of every woman that you love,” Jackson said. “The science is clear: Hormone therapy is safe and effective. And it is hugely beneficial to the vast majority of women.”
Less clear that day were the financial benefits the new policy could bring Jackson, according to disclosure records obtained by ProPublica.

Jackson is the founder and former chief executive of Evernow, an online platform that connects women with medical experts who treat the symptoms of menopause. Although she left for federal service last year, she kept at least $115,000 in Evernow stock and an unknown amount of stock options, records show.

Those are just part of a multimillion-dollar portfolio Jackson holds with her husband, a venture capitalist, that poses potential conflicts of interest with her work overseeing the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health, known as ARPA-H.

It’s unclear what role, if any, Jackson played in dropping the black box warning, the most serious type of federal safety warning that is reserved for drugs with severe side effects or life-threatening risks. A different agency, the Food and Drug Administration, regulates drugs, and its panel of experts had recommended an end to the warning requirement months before Jackson arrived in government.

But ethics experts called Jackson’s official endorsement of the warning removal “alarming” and an “obvious conflict of interest,” noting federal law prohibits government employees from participating “personally and substantially” in matters that could influence their personal finances — even making statements at a press conference or in a news release, as she also did.

“We should care because her company is apparently intending to profit off this change in policy that she endorsed as a government official while still retaining a financial interest in the company,” said Virginia Canter, who served as an ethics lawyer at the White House, Treasury Department and Securities and Exchange Commission during the presidencies of George H.W. Bush, Bill Clinton, George W. Bush and Barack Obama.
“I say it puts her within the zone of a potential violation,” she said.
Months after the announced end to the warning notices, Evernow launched a nationwide expansion.

Under federal law, agency officials like Jackson are required to submit financial disclosure forms, which must then be certified as complying with ethics laws. But Jackson’s two financial disclosures — filed last October and two months ago — remain uncertified. Canter said it is not unusual for an agency’s ethics office to ask the inspector general to investigate if staff cannot certify that an individual’s disclosure forms meet ethics standards.

Over two months, ProPublica sought comment from Jackson and submitted questions about her work, investments and ethics records. Jackson did not respond, and HHS never addressed our detailed questions.

But in a statement to ProPublica last week, an agency spokesperson said Jackson has been placed on administrative leave and HHS would “assess the facts before determining any change in her status. HHS requires all officials to comply with federal ethics laws, regulations, and policies.”
HHS declined to answer additional questions about the reasons for Jackson’s leave, the decision’s timing or whether the inspector general was investigating.

Earlier this week, Bloomberg Law reported on the HHS statement that Jackson was on leave and made public a draft memo by one of the agency’s senior officials that would have granted Jackson a conflict waiver involving many of her and her husband’s extensive investments. Since she joined ARPA-H, the memo said, Jackson and her husband’s financial ties required her to recuse herself from “a significant portion” of her duties, including discussions about funding awarded by her agency. The waiver named 30 investments and would have allowed Jackson to take part in decisions that could affect those interests. Evernow is not listed.

Bloomberg reported that two firms with ties to Jackson sought ARPA-H funding, but it was unclear if either received any. HHS did not respond to ProPublica’s questions asking whether the waiver was ever granted or if the firms had received money from ARPA-H. The Office of Government Ethics does not list Jackson among federal officials who have received waivers.

Jackson’s disclosures are among 2,400 added Thursday to ProPublica’s Trump Team Financials database, a searchable tool launched in March. The records detail the finances of more than 2,300 officials appointed by President Donald Trump. Since last year, we’ve requested disclosure records from 127 federal agencies and the White House. Disclosures from roughly 1,500 appointees remain unreleased.

The Trump administration’s massive cuts to the federal bureaucracy have taken a toll on the ranks of ethics staff. By the end of 2025, there were 274 fewer full-time ethics officials, according to a recent analysis of federal survey records by the government watchdog group Campaign Legal Center. Some agencies said the losses hampered ethics officers’ ability to conduct training and monitor employee compliance.

Since she joined ARPA-H, the memo said, Jackson and her husband’s financial ties required her to recuse herself from “a significant portion” of her duties, including discussions about funding awarded by her agency. The waiver named 30 investments and would have allowed Jackson to take part in decisions that could affect those interests. Evernow is not listed.
paragraphs.zh: 本周早些时候，彭博法律（Bloomberg Law）报道了HHS关于杰克逊休假的声明，并公开了该机构一位高级官员起草的一份备忘录草案，该草案原本要给杰克逊一项利益冲突豁免，涉及她和丈夫的众多大额投资。备忘录称，自她加入ARPA-H以来，杰克逊与丈夫的财务关系使她必须回避“相当一部分”职责，包括有关其所在机构拨款事宜的讨论。该豁免列出了30项投资，一旦获批便可允许杰克逊参与可能影响这些利益的决策。Evernow并不在名单上。

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg reported that two firms with ties to Jackson sought ARPA-H funding, but it was unclear if either received any. HHS did not respond to ProPublica’s questions asking whether the waiver was ever granted or if the firms had received money from ARPA-H. The Office of Government Ethics does not list Jackson among federal officials who have received waivers.
paragraphs.zh: 彭博报道称，有两家与杰克逊有关联的公司曾申请ARPA-H的资金，但不清楚其中是否有任何一家拿到钱。对于该豁免是否最终获批、这两家公司是否从ARPA-H获得过资金，HHS没有回应ProPublica的提问。在政府伦理办公室（Office of Government Ethics）公布的获得豁免的联邦官员名单中，也没有杰克逊的名字。

paragraphs.en: Jackson’s disclosures are among 2,400 added Thursday to ProPublica’s Trump Team Financials database, a searchable tool launched in March. The records detail the finances of more than 2,300 officials appointed by President Donald Trump. Since last year, we’ve requested disclosure records from 127 federal agencies and the White House. Disclosures from roughly 1,500 appointees remain unreleased.
paragraphs.zh: 周四，ProPublica的“特朗普团队财务状况”数据库一次性新增了2400份申报记录，杰克逊的申报也在其中。该数据库是今年3月上线的可检索工具，详细记录了唐纳德·特朗普总统任命的两千三百多名官员的财务状况。自去年以来，我们已向127个联邦机构及白宫索取申报记录。目前仍有约1500名被任命者的申报材料没有公开。

paragraphs.en: The Trump administration’s massive cuts to the federal bureaucracy have taken a toll on the ranks of ethics staff. By the end of 2025, there were 274 fewer full-time ethics officials, according to a recent analysis of federal survey records by the government watchdog group Campaign Legal Center. Some agencies said the losses hampered ethics officers’ ability to conduct training and monitor employee compliance.
paragraphs.zh: 特朗普政府对联邦官僚体系的大规模削减，已经损害了伦理工作人员队伍。根据政府监督组织“竞选法律中心”（Campaign Legal Center）最近对联邦调查记录的分析，到2025年底，全职伦理官员减少了274人。一些机构表示，人员流失削弱了伦理官员开展培训、监督员工合规的能力。

vocab.meaning_zh: 黑框警告（美国FDA药品标签上最严厉的安全警示，用粗黑边框圈出，通常用于有严重甚至致命风险的药物）
vocab.example_en: The FDA added a black box warning to the drug after reports of severe liver damage.
vocab.example_zh: 在出现严重肝损伤的报告后，FDA在该药品标签上加注了黑框警告。

vocab.meaning_zh: 污名，羞耻感；（某事物因被误解而背负的）负面标签
vocab.example_en: The campaign aims to remove the stigma surrounding menopause in the workplace.
vocab.example_zh: 这项活动旨在消除职场中对更年期的污名化。

vocab.meaning_zh: 激素替代疗法（HRT），通过补充雌激素等缓解更年期症状的治疗方式
vocab.example_en: Hormone replacement therapy can relieve hot flashes but is not suitable for everyone.
vocab.example_zh: 激素替代疗法可以缓解潮热，但并非人人适用。

vocab.meaning_zh: （供演讲者放讲稿的）斜面讲台、演讲台
vocab.example_en: She stepped behind the lectern and waited for the applause to die down.
vocab.example_zh: 她走到讲台后，等掌声平息下来。

vocab.meaning_zh: （熟词僻义）投资组合，一个人持有的全部金融资产
vocab.example_en: Ethics rules require officials to disclose any holdings in their investment portfolio.
vocab.example_zh: 伦理规则要求官员披露其投资组合中的任何持股。

vocab.meaning_zh: （因利益冲突而）主动回避、退出某项事务
vocab.example_en: The official recused herself from the contract review because her brother owned the bidding firm.
vocab.example_zh: 由于她弟弟拥有投标公司，这位官员回避了该合同的审核。

vocab.meaning_zh: 豁免（书），官方允许某人不受某项规定的约束
vocab.example_en: He was granted a waiver allowing him to work on issues affecting his former employer.
vocab.example_zh: 他获得了一份豁免，可以参与涉及其前雇主的议题。

vocab.meaning_zh: 行政休假（通常带有停职调查性质，当事人仍保留职务和薪水）
vocab.example_en: The director was placed on administrative leave pending an internal investigation.
vocab.example_zh: 在内部调查进行期间，该局长被安排行政休假。

vocab.meaning_zh: 背书，公开支持、认可（尤指有影响力者或官方人士的公开表态）
vocab.example_en: Her endorsement of the policy gave it credibility with the public.
vocab.example_zh: 她对这项政策的公开支持为其赢得了公众信任。

vocab.meaning_zh: 对……造成损害、造成负面影响（常用于形容持续的损耗）
vocab.example_en: Years of budget cuts have taken a toll on the agency's oversight capacity.
vocab.example_zh: 多年的预算削减已经损害了该机构的监管能力。

sentences.en: It’s unclear what role, if any, Jackson played in dropping the black box warning, the most serious type of federal safety warning that is reserved for drugs with severe side effects or life-threatening risks.
sentences.structure: 主干：It's unclear + 主语从句 what role ... Jackson played（It 为形式主语）/ 插入语：if any / 同位语：the most serious type of federal safety warning，其后接 that 定语从句修饰 warning
sentences.analysis_zh: 句子以 It 作形式主语开头，真正的主语是 what role Jackson played；played 的宾语就是句首的 what role。if any 是插入成分，意思是“如果有的话”，作者用它提前给“杰克逊是否参与”打了问号——这是新闻报道中避免断言、留出法律余地的常见写法。后半部分用同位语解释“黑框警告”是什么，再用 that 从句限定它的适用范围（副作用严重或有致命风险），相当于在句子内部插入了一段背景说明，让不熟悉的读者不必中断阅读去查资料。

sentences.en: But ethics experts called Jackson’s official endorsement of the warning removal “alarming” and an “obvious conflict of interest,” noting federal law prohibits government employees from participating “personally and substantially” in matters that could influence their personal finances — even making statements at a press conference or in a news release, as she also did.
sentences.structure: 主干：ethics experts called Jackson's endorsement “alarming” and an “obvious conflict of interest”（call + 宾语 + 宾补）/ 修饰：现在分词短语 noting ... 作伴随状语，说明依据 / 宾语从句：federal law prohibits ... from participating in matters / 定语从句：that could influence their personal finances / 破折号后：even making statements ... 进一步补足 participating 的范围，as she also did 为方式/比较从句
sentences.analysis_zh: 主句是简单的“主+谓+宾+宾补”结构，真正复杂的是 noting 引导的伴随状语：它为前面的指控提供法律依据，相当于“理由是……”。prohibit sb from doing sth 中，doing 的宾语是 participating in matters，matters 后面挂 that 定语从句。破折号后的 even making statements 是对 participating 的“下限延伸”——连在发布会上讲话也算参与，而 as she also did 则把这条法律标准直接扣回到杰克逊身上，使论证从抽象规则变成具体指控。这种“主句给结论＋分词状语给依据＋破折号收口”的写法，是英文评论与调查报道中常见的说理节奏。

sentences.en: Since she joined ARPA-H, the memo said, Jackson and her husband’s financial ties required her to recuse herself from “a significant portion” of her duties, including discussions about funding awarded by her agency.
sentences.structure: 主干：Jackson and her husband's financial ties required her to recuse herself from ... / 状语从句：Since she joined ARPA-H / 插入语：the memo said（引述来源）/ 介词短语：including discussions about funding awarded by her agency，修饰 her duties
sentences.analysis_zh: 句子主干是 require sb to do sth 的变体：financial ties required her to recuse herself from a significant portion of her duties。句首的 Since 从句交代时间起点，the memo said 是插入的引述标记，用来提示“以下几句话出自备忘录而非记者判断”，这是调查报道保持中立、把责任归于文件来源的手法。including ... 部分是对“相当一部分职责”的具体化，其中 awarded by her agency 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 funding，点明被回避的正是最核心的拨款权——这也是后文说豁免“本可让她重新参与决策”的原因。

background.title: 激素替代疗法与“黑框警告”的来龙去脉
background.text_zh: 激素替代疗法（HRT）指给更年期女性补充雌激素（常联合孕激素）以缓解潮热、盗汗、骨质疏松等症状。2002年，美国一项名为“女性健康倡议”（WHI）的大型研究公布结果，称长期使用激素疗法可能提高乳腺癌、血栓和心血管事件风险，此后FDA在相关药品标签上加了“黑框警告”——这是联邦药品安全警示中最高级别，用粗黑边框突出，通常只用于风险严重甚至致命的药物。该警告导致大量女性与医生弃用HRT，处方量骤降，这一现象被学界称为“WHI后遗症”。此后二十余年，多项再分析指出当年结论对年龄分层等因素考虑不足，对较年轻、刚绝经女性的绝对风险被高估，于是近年出现“为HRT平反”的潮流，此次HHS取消黑框警告正是这一趋势的政策体现。因此文中“add up to a decade of healthy years”的说法，指的就是重新用药可能带来的健康收益。

background.title: ARPA-H、财产申报与利益冲突豁免制度
background.text_zh: ARPA-H（Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health）是拜登政府2022年设立的联邦卫生机构，模仿国防部的DARPA模式，专门资助高风险、高回报的生物医学突破性研究，2024财年预算约15亿美元，因此对生物医药和数字医疗初创公司具有巨大的资金吸引力。按照美国联邦伦理规则，行政 branch 官员须提交财产申报表（OGE Form 278e），由所在机构的伦理办公室审核并“认证”（certify）其合规；若官员持有的资产与其职责范围重叠，通常有两种处理：一是签订“回避协议”或作出回避承诺（recusal），不参与相关事项；二是由机构伦理部门签发“利益冲突豁免”（waiver），在公开披露的前提下允许其参与。豁免须依法公告，政府伦理办公室（OGE）会公开列出获豁免者。若申报表长期无法认证，机构可请监察长（inspector general）介入调查，这也是本文追问的关键点。

title_en: In an AI blow-up, would insurance pay out?
excerpt_en: Credit default swaps are back in vogue amid fears of a debt disaster

enrich.summary_zh: 标题提出假设性问题：AI 领域若发生爆雷式事件，保险是否会赔付；提要则称，在债务灾难担忧升温之际，信用违约互换（CDS）重新流行。材料只有标题和提要，没有给出结论，二者将 AI 风险与信用风险工具并置。

paragraphs.en: Credit default swaps are back in vogue amid fears of a debt disaster
paragraphs.zh: 在人们对债务灾难的担忧中，信用违约互换（CDS）重新流行起来。

vocab.meaning_zh: 流行；重新时兴
vocab.example_en: Short-term rentals are in vogue again in big cities.
vocab.example_zh: 短租在大城市里又重新流行起来。

vocab.meaning_zh: 信用违约互换（CDS），一种用于转移债券或贷款违约风险的金融衍生品
vocab.example_en: Investors bought credit default swaps to hedge against a default.
vocab.example_zh: 投资者买入信用违约互换，以对冲违约风险。

vocab.meaning_zh: 在……之中；伴随……
vocab.example_en: The shares rose amid reports of a takeover.
vocab.example_zh: 在收购报道的背景下，股价上涨。

vocab.meaning_zh: 爆雷；突然崩溃；重大事故（标题中借指 AI 领域的突然崩塌或大乱子）
vocab.example_en: The hedge fund collapsed in a sudden blow-up.
vocab.example_zh: 那家对冲基金在一场突如其来的爆雷中崩溃。

vocab.meaning_zh: 赔付；支付
vocab.example_en: The policy pays out only if a named storm hits the coast.
vocab.example_zh: 只有指定风暴袭击海岸时，这份保单才会赔付。

sentences.en: Credit default swaps are back in vogue amid fears of a debt disaster
sentences.structure: 主干：Credit default swaps are back in vogue；修饰：amid fears of a debt disaster 作状语，交代背景或原因。
sentences.analysis_zh: are back in vogue 是系表结构，back 强调“重新”，in vogue 表示“流行”；amid 引导的介词短语说明这种流行发生在对债务灾难的担忧之中。全句用词经济，先给现象再给背景，是典型的财经提要写法。

background.title: CDS（信用违约互换）
background.text_zh: 信用违约互换是一种场外金融衍生品：买方定期向卖方支付费用，若约定的参考实体发生信用事件（如违约、破产或重组），卖方向买方赔付。它常被类比为债券违约保险，但并非传统保险合约，2008 年金融危机前后因放大金融体系风险而广受争议。“AI blow-up”不是 CDS 合同中的标准信用事件，标题只是借用“保险是否赔付”的通俗说法设问。

title_en: Sam Bankman-Fried says he has paid his debts
excerpt_en: The crypto tycoon speaks with The Economist from prison in California

enrich.title_zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德称自己已还清债务
enrich.summary_zh: 《经济学人》刊出对萨姆·班克曼-弗里德的狱中采访。这位加密货币交易平台 FTX 的创始人因欺诈等罪名正在加利福尼亚州的监狱服刑，他在采访中表示自己「已经还清债务」。现有提要只交代了采访对象、采访地点和他的这一说法，并未透露其具体主张与依据。

paragraphs.en: The crypto tycoon speaks with The Economist from prison in California
paragraphs.zh: 这位加密货币大亨在加利福尼亚州的监狱中接受了《经济学人》的采访。

vocab.meaning_zh: （商界）大亨、巨头，指在某一行业握有巨大财富与权势的人物；外刊常搭配 media tycoon、shipping tycoon、crypto tycoon。
vocab.example_en: The shipping tycoon built his fortune on a single container route.
vocab.example_zh: 这位航运大亨的财富起于一条集装箱航线。

vocab.meaning_zh: 加密货币（的），cryptocurrency 的口语缩略形式，多作定语：crypto tycoon、crypto exchange、crypto market。
vocab.example_en: Regulators are tightening their grip on the crypto industry.
vocab.example_zh: 监管机构正在收紧对加密货币行业的管控。

vocab.meaning_zh: 与……交谈；在新闻提要中特指「接受某媒体采访」，比 speak to 更强调双向对谈，是《经济学人》等刊物的固定说法。
vocab.example_en: The minister spoke with our correspondent in Brussels.
vocab.example_zh: 这位部长在布鲁塞尔接受了我们记者的采访。

vocab.meaning_zh: 还清债务、偿还欠款；引申义为「付出代价、了结旧账」，标题用此语双关，既有金钱义，也有「向世人交代」的意味。
vocab.example_en: He insists the company has paid its debts in full.
vocab.example_zh: 他坚称公司已全额偿还了债务。

vocab.meaning_zh: 从狱中、在监狱里（发出某一动作）；新闻提要常用这一介词短语交代消息来源的处境，不交代具体刑期或罪名。
vocab.example_en: The interview was conducted from prison by letter.
vocab.example_zh: 这次采访是他从狱中通过书信完成的。

sentences.en: The crypto tycoon speaks with The Economist from prison in California
sentences.structure: 主干：The crypto tycoon（主语）+ speaks with（谓语）+ The Economist（宾语）；修饰：from prison（地点状语，说明采访发生的处境）+ in California（修饰 prison，限定所在州）。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这是一句典型的英文杂志「提要」（standfirst）：一个主谓宾加两个介词短语，把人物身份（crypto tycoon）、动作（speaks with The Economist）、地点（from prison in California）全部压缩进十来个词。三点值得学：一、用一般现在时 speaks 而不用过去时，这是标题与提要的惯用体（timeless present），让消息显得「正在进行」；二、先给人物的身份标签而不是姓名（标题里才出现姓名），让不熟悉此事的读者一眼知道他是谁；三、地点信息按「由近及远」排列，from prison 在前、in California 在后，读者先获得「在狱中」这一最意外的信息，再补上具体在哪里。

background.title: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德与 FTX 案的来龙去脉
background.text_zh: 萨姆·班克曼-弗里德（Sam Bankman-Fried，圈内常简称 SBF）是美国加密货币交易所 FTX 的创始人，FTX 一度是全球最大的加密交易平台之一，估值曾达数百亿美元。2022 年 11 月，媒体披露其关联交易公司 Alameda Research 挪用了 FTX 客户的资金，交易所随即在数日内崩盘并申请破产，大量用户无法提取存款。2023 年 11 月，纽约联邦陪审团裁定其欺诈、共谋等七项罪名成立；2024 年 3 月，法官判处其 25 年监禁，并同时下达了金额约 110 亿美元的没收令（forfeiture）与赔偿令（restitution）。他先被关押在纽约布鲁克林的都会拘留中心，后被转往加利福尼亚州的联邦监狱服刑，这也正是提要中「from prison in California」的事实依据。需要注意，此类刑事没收与赔偿令属于法院判决的金钱义务，与当事人自己对外宣称的「已还清债务」并不是同一回事，二者口径不同，阅读时不宜混为一谈。《经济学人》素来有派记者探访入狱知名人物做长篇专访的传统，这类稿件通常以狱中书信、探监记录或电话访谈为基础。
